alice.chen: :rotating_light: incident-bot paged: autoscaler failing to provision GPUs in gcp-latinamerica1 — quotaExceeded on GPUs. Queue growing.
incident-bot: PAGER: Incident 3412345678 — autoscaler error 'quotaExceeded' in region latinamerica1. Severity: high. Please ack.
samir: acked. looking now. any customer impact yet?
jessicah: UI reported 503 spikes and backlog of ~1.2k pending requests. Latency median up from 120ms -> 860ms on some routes.
oliver-k: I'm seeing scale events stuck at 'pendingProvision' with error: `googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'GPUS' for project 12345... exceeded`. Full stack in logs:
```
ERROR autoscaler.Manager: provision failed: quotaExceeded: availableGPUs=0 requested=8 region=latinamerica1 project=redwood-prod
```
miguel: it's hitting our soft quota for the region — we have 20/20 GPUs allocated, max allowed 20. Autoscaler is trying to add nodes but quota refused.
alice.chen: customer-impact: 12 customers on Dedicated pools in that region showing request timeouts; Hosted API degraded for latam region. Sending note to CS.
support-lucy: notified affected accounts (IDs: acct-241, acct-998, acct-310) and opened status page draft. any interim mitigation?
samir: immediate mitigations: 1) route latency-sensitive traffic to us-east4 fallback pool (if route policy allows) 2) switch non-critical dedicated jobs to low-priority preemptible VMs in region (if quota permits) 3) enable model-quantized variants for some routes to reduce GPU ramp
jessicah: preferring controlled routing — can we flip routing for 20% traffic to us-east4 as canary?
oliver-k: yes, adding route rule now: `route.set --from=latam-region --to=us-east4 --pct=20 --reason=latinamerica1-gpu-quota` — applying.
miguel: started request to GCP for quota increase (case: 45678) — but ETA is multi-hour.
alice.chen: can we also temporarily drop batch sizes for hosted inference to reduce per-GPU memory? patching runtime config.
samir: patch deployed to reduce batch_max_tokens from 2048 -> 1024 for affected pools.
incident-bot: update: new logs show pending queue stabilized but still ~400 pending, CPU/RAM healthy on existing nodes.
jessicah: CS pushed status update. customers asking about ETA and failover.
support-lucy: set priority for acct-241 (high) to route -> us-east4 fallback; they'll be on region fallback in ~3 minutes.
alice.chen: timeline: t0=3412345678 autoscaler paged; t+4m routing 20% to us-east4; t+10m batch size reduced; t+12m partial customer reroutes; queue falls from 1.2k -> 380
samir: next steps: continue quota increase request, escalate to account team, monitor for new spikes. if backlog increases above 1k, trigger broader failover.
jessicah: handing off to oncall-night (oliver-k) for overnight watch. leaving playbook notes.
oliver-k: ack — I'll run the watch and check for any regressions. ping me if queue >700 or new 5xxs rise.
alice.chen: thanks team. creating post-incident ticket for follow-up: root cause = region quota cap + autoscaler retry logic not failing fast; action items: adjust fallback routing thresholds, preemptive quota monitor, automation to throttle new pool launches under quota errors.
incident-bot: Incident 3412345678 status: mitigated -> monitoring. :white_check_mark:
samir: closing this thread and adding to oncall notes.
